subject: Post-call: LensMed pricing guardrails & host comparisons
messages:
From: Alice Turner <alice.turner@lensmed.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro call — quick recap & ask on $/1M comparisons

Thanks for the intro call earlier — quick recap from our side and what we need to make next steps fast: 

- Monthly volume (estimate): ~20M tokens/month initially, scaling to ~60M over 12 months.
- Usage mix: ~70% short chat-style prompts (avg 180 tokens total), ~30% longer document-parsing/summary flows (avg 2,200 tokens).
- Embeddings: light (search+RAG) — roughly 5% of total tokens.
- Budget range: LensMed is thinking $8k — $15k / month for inference (not including storage/infra).

Primary ask: can you provide a target $/1M token price that would make this fit the budget envelope AND a brief comparison vs OpenAI/Anthropic/other open-hosts for the same workload assumptions. If you can do a short monthly-cost example (20M tokens) at the target price and at the host comparators that would be helpful.

Attached: call recording + our internal playbook (high level) — happy to answer any clarifying Qs. Ideally we land on a numbers-based follow-up next week.

Thanks — Alice
Alice Turner
Head of AI Product, LensMed
From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@lensmed.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Sep 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro call — quick recap & ask on $/1M comparisons

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear summary and the playbook. Posting a short list of clarifying points so we size and price appropriately: 

1) Can you confirm the 20M number is monthly active tokens (production usage) vs developer/test traffic?
2) For the long-document flows, are you doing full-context passes every request or using smart chunking + KV caching?
3) Any hard latency SLOs on the long flows (>2s, <500ms, etc.)? That changes model choice.

Assuming 20M/month production, mixed short/long split above, and typical latency SLOs for enterprise apps (~<800ms for chat), we'll put together:
- a target Redwood $/1M token price (reserved + pilot discount scenario),
- a comparison vs 3 host profiles (OpenAI, Anthropic, and a common open-host provider), and
- a worked example monthly cost at 20M tokens.

I'm attaching a short question checklist (lensmed_playbook_questions.docx) — if you can drop answers inline or send a short note, we'll run numbers and get back by EOD tomorrow PST. Also proposing a 30-min follow-up Tue (09/22) to review.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Sep 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: quick benchmark and suggested price floor for LensMed

Internal note — drafting a short, conservative benchmark we can share with OLGA after she confirms the clarifying items. Assumptions: 20M tokens/month, mix as noted, typical enterprise latency (~<800ms chat), they want production SLAs but are price-sensitive and open to a reserved commit.

Quick comparative grid (per 1M tokens) — workload-adjusted effective price (includes expected batching/caching gains and a reserved discount for Redwood):
- Redwood (reserved pilot profile): $420 / 1M tokens
- Other open-host provider (managed open models): $620 / 1M tokens
- Anthropic (Rumble-style pricing proxy): $950 / 1M tokens
- OpenAI (high-capacity chat models): $1,200 / 1M tokens

Worked example (20M tokens / month):
- Redwood: 20 * $420 = $8,400 / month
- Other open-host: 20 * $620 = $12,400 / month
- Anthropic proxy: 20 * $950 = $19,000 / month
- OpenAI: 20 * $1,200 = $24,000 / month

Why Redwood is lower: smart KV prefix caching for longer docs, continuous batching on chat workloads, and an option for a small quantized model variant for the long-form summarization paths. We can also offer an aggressive pilot commit (3 months) at $380 / 1M to get them into the reserved pool for additional savings once they scale.

Risks / notes to call out when we share:
- If their long-form flows do full-context passes every time (no caching), token cost will jump 15–30% vs our estimate.
- Embedding-heavy search can raise effective cost if done synchronously at high QPS; recommend async embed refresh + caching.

Attaching a first-pass pricing grid I can clean up for the external deck (redwood_pricing_grid_v1.xlsx).

— Ben
From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@lensmed.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro call — LensMed pricing guardrails & host comparisons

Alice — thanks again for the helpful call and the materials. We've run a quick, conservative benchmark and see a viable path to land inside your stated budget range. Summary below — please confirm the three clarifying bullets (marked ACTION) and we can lock in a short pilot pricing proposal.

Summary (assumptions: 20M prod tokens/month; 70% chat, 30% longer docs; light embeddings):
- Recommended Redwood target: $420 / 1M tokens (pilot offer: $380 / 1M for a 3-month commit).
- Comparable hosts (workload-adjusted): Other open-host ~ $620 / 1M; Anthropic ~ $950 / 1M; OpenAI ~ $1,200 / 1M.
- Monthly cost @ 20M tokens: Redwood target = $8,400/mo (pilot = $7,600/mo).

ACTION (please reply inline):
1) Confirm 20M is production tokens (not test/dev).
2) For long-document flows, confirm whether you will use chunking + KV caching or full-context passes.
3) Any required latency SLOs for chat vs summary flows?

Next steps:
- If confirmed, we'll send a 3-month pilot quote (includes reserved capacity and a light trial SLA) + a short appendix describing caching/architecture steps to hit the target price.
- Proposed follow-up: Tue 09/22, 11:00 AM PT — 30 min to review the quote and technical checklist.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_grid_v1.xlsx (worked numbers), call recording.

If that schedule works I'll send a calendar invite.

Best regards,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
